message.content: {"caption":"Vertical bar chart comparing SpreadsheetBench-Vrf pass rates for reference skills, concurrent systems, and Trace2Skill variants.","description":"The vertical axis is SpreadsheetBench-Vrf (%) and runs from 0 to 80, with ticks every 20 points. The horizontal axis lists eight systems. Gray bars are Reference skills: No Skill, 27.7%, and Human-Written, 48.3%. A dashed horizontal line marks the Human-Written reference value of 48.3%. Blue bars are Concurrent systems: XSkill, 23%; SkillGen, 27.5%; EvoSkill (Claude Code), 33.5%; and EvoSkill (React), 59.5%. Green bars are Trace2Skill (ours): Trace2Skill +Error, 65.8%, and Trace2Skill +Combined, 69.8%. Among the concurrent systems, EvoSkill (React) is above the dashed reference line and the other three are below it.
